china-1931-2:p0366_1.rationale: Half-year deposits, withdrawals, interest and balances of Chinese Postal Savings Banks by district. Savings and deposit balances fit savings-and-loans.

china-1931-2:p0367_1.rationale: Continuation of postal savings statement: partial and complete withdrawals, amounts debited and amounts due to depositors by district.

china-1931-2:p0368_1.rationale: Postal savings account movements by district: operations, accounts opened, closed, transferred and open, with average balances.

china-1931-2:p0369_1.rationale: Domestic money orders issued and cashed by district, in numbers and values, across two fiscal years; a postal remittance channel.

china-1931-2:p0370_1.rationale: Profit and loss account of the Postal Savings Banks, covering interest, exchange and working expenses in two currencies. It is a financial account of a savings institution.
review_questions: Is a tag for bank or institutional accounts needed? None of the existing tags fits a savings bank's own accounts exactly.

china-1931-2:p0371_1.rationale: Balance sheet of the Post Office Savings Bank with depositors' accounts, investments and cash in two currencies.

china-1931-2:p0373_1.rationale: Telegram rates per word in francs, ordinary and press, from China to Japan.

china-1931-2:p0373_2.rationale: Telegram rates per word in francs, ordinary and press, to Europe, Russia and the USA.

china-1931-2:p0373_3.rationale: Telegraph line route distances, overland and river cables, and wire lengths by district.

china-1931-2:p0374_1.rationale: Inventory of short-wave radio stations with call signs, power, wavelengths and linked stations. The stations serve radiotelegraph communication.
